Well, I'm not sure if this is what you are looking for, but I write a
(theoretically) monthly Tremere Clan Newsletter. After I have a
chance to analyze some new stuff in Bloodlines, my next issue will be
coming out. I believe there is also someone writing a Gargoyle
Newsletter, but I can't remember for certain (and I just can't be
bothered to Google it up). I think it's Norm, maybe? Shoot. (Okay,
I *did* just check, and rock on, I was right.) Go Norm!

I archive my newsletters at
http://www.waste.org/~xian/geek/jyhad/news/ , and you can find lots of
information at www.thelasombra.com.

That being said, feel free to talk about any- (and every-) thing
Tremere/Gargoyle that you like. If you want to post stuff on the
newsgroup, go for it. If you want to send me something for inclusion
in the newsletter, please do so.

> Now with the gargolyes in (fly) the Tremere have "lots?" of news
> strategies , whichs it can give us too new decks based in the
> Pot/Fortitude/Auspex, etc...

Well, I don't know about lots of new strategies, but there are new
options within pre-existing archetypes. (I'd say that a new strategy
is something like the Harbingers library destruction.) That being
said, the Gargoyles can add some punch, as it were, to
Tremere/!Tremere decks that use POT or FOR (though not so much to the
Dawn Op/Weather Control deck) in combat, and Visciktera (or whatever)
has some nifty effects for THA as well. If you're not using the
Gargoyles as a solo clan, they definitely have a lot to offer the
(!)Tremere.

I think Clan Impersonation is going to be an interesting addition to
any deck with a high number of Gargoyles. Sanguine Instruction is
also a good all-around card, it's looking like. (Especially when
combined with CI.)

> I like that all of u ( if u wanna) post here if u like the idea of
> found here a Tremere Chantry as discussion forum ( i it exist , plz
> say me ;-) ),

Well, like I said, check my website or The Lasombra's, let us know if
that is or is not what you mean.

> - comment news decks.
> - Vissceratic will help us or only confuse us?

Nah, it's not that confusing. Mmmm...Armor of Terra.

> - Is the deck Gargolyes/Tremere playabled in a Tournament?

Well, I obviously don't know about the Gargoyles yet, but the Tremere
definitely are. I think that there have been 4 Tremere decks that
have won tournaments since August or so? The Tremere *can* win, one
just has to know what to do with them. (Repeat after me: the Tremere
are not just Thaumaturgy combat machines.)

Xian

Visceratika seems quite impressive in my opinion, both in itself and
as a supplement to the (!)Tremere. The abilities are really quite
